request: When several RETURNING clauses are added to one statement their columns accumulate in order, except that an empty RETURNING clause means all columns: once an empty one is part of the merge, the statement renders RETURNING *, whatever column lists come before or after it.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: Fixed Empty Returning Clause Merge Bug (#7339)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > clause/returning_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestReturning)$' ./clause >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
